In current XLISP

assume you are on tty 50, so that the sixbit symbol whose value
is 50 is 5 spaces followed by a capital-H 

(setq foo (open '((spy) |     H|) '(in ascii single)))
#FILE-IN-|SPY:* *|-70754

(read foo) <now type some characters>
MPV; RDCHAR+1>>MOVE B,@RSXTB   B/   AOJE F,SSTTY3   202354/   ??

This may be an artifact of 12 bit input sources (Space Cadet Keyboards)
